name: Youth Opportunities Advisory Board (City of Boulder)
org: City of Boulder, Youth Opportunities Program
what_you_do: Join up to 16 Boulder teens who advise the city. You give teen ideas on city plans and run a grant program that pays for youth programs.
who_can_apply: Current and rising high school students who live in the City of Boulder. One line on the page also allows teens who go to high school in the city. No ages are listed.
duration: One year terms that can be renewed
deadline_text: The board page says applications are open year round, but it also names the 2025 to 2026 board. Ask staff if a spot is open.
how_to_apply: Use the online form on the board page, in English or Spanish. Questions: Mario Martinez-Varelas, 720-498-2482.
notes: The Youth Opportunities page says the city will not host paid youth internships for 2026 to 2027, and maybe longer. It also links a list of local youth programs and a volunteer booklet.
